name: materi
description: Materi + Skills. A skill IS a materi (`lessons.kind === "skill"` + `promptText`), so ONE slice serves both: /k/<t>/materi and /k/<t>/skills are the same paginated member-gated read with a different kind, the same tag rack, the same three-way sort, the same inset rows and the same permalink shape. Skill-specific: a server search over title OR prompt text, the copy-able PROMPT PANEL above the body, and an empty state that explains what a skill is. Read-only slice; writes stay in the Kelola console.
notes: 0.2.0 (2026-08-10, skills wave): adds the SKILLS surface on top of 0.1.0's materi surface. A skill is not a new table — `lessons.kind` (undefined = "materi", exactly like `status`) plus an optional `promptText` — so tags, search, permalinks, backlinks, OG cards, the sitemap and the block editor all came for free, and only the deltas are new code. THE PROMPT IS MEMBER-ONLY, STRUCTURALLY: `promptText` is absent from `PublicMateri`, so the server component and the opengraph-image have nothing to leak; the barrel test asserts the absence at type level and convex/features/materi/queries.test.ts asserts it key by key. ONE SLUG NAMESPACE, TWO ROUTES: /materi/<slug> and /skills/<slug> each redirect a wrong-kind slug to the canonical route for the row's real kind rather than 404ing (`buildKindPageHref`); a DRAFT reads as null on the anonymous query so no redirect fires, and none is needed — the island renders the row correctly either way, so nothing dead-ends. SORT: newest/oldest ride the index; A→Z is IN-PAGE (lessons has no title index and may not grow one) and the view says so in a footnote rather than faking a global alphabet. SEARCH: the materi library still narrows the LOADED pages client-side; the skills library calls skills:searchSkills, a debounced server query over title OR promptText, which REPLACES the paginated list rather than filtering it (no cursor exists over a bounded scan). The 0.1.0 SSR contract is unchanged and still binding: only publicGetBySlug is read server-side, it answers null for a draft so the page must NOT notFound(), and NO FUNCTION PROP crosses the server→client boundary — the views take `tenantSlug` and `kelolaHref` as strings. The ONE builder prop in the slice is MateriPageHeader's `tagHref`, and that component is a SERVER component rendered by a server component.
